summary: [Google Calendar] webhooks: events.watch creates a web_hook channel to HTTPS endpoint (valid SSL; domain verified in GCP). Notifications carry headers (X-Goog-Channel-ID, X-Goog-Resource-State sync/exists/not_exists, X-Goog-Channel-Token) but NO event data — on notification run an incremental syncToken pass. Channel creation quota 500/day per project; ack 200 fast.
